about: A model that answers in dollars, with a price quoted in euros converted by a rate that is an input of its own. Only an answer must be in the model's currency.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: A quoted price
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  licence_eur:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: EUR/month
    value: 400
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the quoted price, as stated for this case"}

  usd_per_eur:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: USD/EUR
    value: 1.1
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the rate on the day of the quote, as stated for this case"}

  licence_per_core:
    kind: derived
    unit: USD/month/core
    formula: licence_eur * usd_per_eur / cores

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - licence_per_core
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}

the quoted price, as stated for this case
